hints.hint: The two parts you have to translate are "mitt" and "woch".
What English words do they sound close to, that would make sense when put together to mean "Wednesday"?

subLevels.german: Meine Woche beginnt am Montag und endet am Freitag.
subLevels.reveal: Germans celebrate the end of their workweek with the phrase "Feierabend", literally "celebration evening". Colleagues often mark it with a "Feierabendbier"!
